The '''Scepter of Entreaty''' was a creature similar to a [[tsaisi]]. It was worn instead of a tsaisi when one wished to supplicate the [[Supreme Overlord]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
